scope: Broaden current open-source DWG/DXF/ACIS peer research, distinguish the OpenCADStudio codec/kernel/render paths, refresh the ACadSharp DXF writer boundary, and verify that BRL-CAD's proposed POLYFACE guard preserves DXF signed-index semantics.

method.kind: Read-only review of primary Autodesk DXF entity references, current upstream project documentation/source/test pages, releases, and issue/PR records; cross-checked against the existing local implementation plan and tests.
method.researchBoundary: Project documentation, source snippets, release metadata, and issue/PR reports were reviewed but not executed. OpenCADStudio v2026.41 was identified as the current release; the previously recorded v2026.38 carrier result was not rerun. Peer claims are route-selection and test-design evidence only, not libdxfrw conformance or support results.

evidence.topic: OpenCADStudio/opencadcodec as one optional peer family
observed: OpenCADStudio advertises native DWG/DXF read/write and 3D modeling; its v2026.41 release tag points to cff240e.

The codec repository advertises DWG/DXF and SAT/SAB access and is a fork of the hakanaktt/acadrust project; the app, codec, and related ACadRust/CADCraft routes must not be counted as multiple independent reader votes.
The already documented OpenCADStudio v2026.38 carrier/history read is an exact-build historical observation, not a current v2026.41 result.

The public docs use multiple crate/project names and release lines, so the exact app, codec, and kernel source revisions must be resolved from the selected artifact's lockfile at the time of a composed run.
doesNotEstablish: per-version, per-entity conformance for arbitrary drawings
independent ACIS semantics from a same-project codec/kernel
latest-release behavior from the earlier v2026.38 run
native AutoCAD/ProgeCAD compatibility from README or API matrices
evidence.planUse: Admit OpenCADStudio as one optional composed-checkpoint peer family only; pin release and lockfile dependencies, and keep it out of dependencies and per-slice tests.

observed: The project documents ACIS Solid3D/Region/Body/Surface rendering through a kernel body lift and per-face triangulation, with a per-surface fallback when the kernel cannot express a face; incomplete lifts are intended to be marked.
The guide describes direct fan-triangulated display fill for Face3D, Mesh, PolyfaceMesh, and PolygonMesh.
doesNotEstablish: complete B-rep recovery or valid closed solids for all ACIS records
that a fallback surface sample preserves analytic topology
correct triangulation of arbitrary concave mesh faces
source entity, owner, or INSERT placement completeness from viewport pixels
evidence.planUse: Record kernel-lift versus fallback/incomplete status, source ownership, topology, closedness, diagnostics, and analytic metrics; compare mesh fields directly and limit rendered fill checks to triangles or known-convex faces.

evidence.observed: An open issue reports errors opening app-generated 3D DWGs in AutoCAD/ProgeCAD. Later comments report improvements and one maintainer test against a strict third-party reader, but the issue has no pinned drawing hash, exact reproducible command, per-entity census, or independent analytic metric set.
doesNotEstablish: a reproducible current release failure or pass
correct ACIS shape semantics or all writer versions
a defect in libdxfrw
evidence.planUse: Use as a writer-interoperability test-design lead only. Require a local asymmetric source control, pinned app and target-reader versions, exact output readback, entity disposition, and analytic geometry assertions.

evidence.observed: The open report describes 3DSOLID/REGION omission by a reported v3.4.9 DXF writer, including solid-only blocks; the maintainer says Solid3D, CadBody, and Region are not yet supported in DXF on the reviewed branch, while linked PR #1240 remains unmerged.
doesNotEstablish: current v3.8.0 runtime behavior
a reproduced local or libdxfrw failure
complete current writer support from an open implementation PR
evidence.planUse: Retain per-source identity, owner/block/INSERT closure, emitted type/carrier, diagnostic, and readback checks; count omission, proxy substitution, refusal, and typed output as distinct outcomes.

evidence.topic: BRL-CAD proposed POLYFACE guard versus valid signed indices
evidence.observed: Open BRL-CAD #228 reports an out-of-range POLYFACE read in dxf-g. Open/unmerged PR #245 proposes requiring each corner index to be >=1 and <= the coordinate count. Autodesk documents negative face indices as legal invisible outgoing-edge markers and the first zero as the face-list terminator.
doesNotEstablish: that BRL-CAD main is fixed
that PR #245 is merged, released, or complete
that the peer patch's positive lower bound is a valid general DXF parser rule
evidence.planUse: Keep the existing local signed-magnitude bounds rule. Validate only active indices, widen before magnitude, compare against actual coordinate count, retain sign, and stop on zero. Reassess the peer only after an exact merged revision and tests are reviewed.

evidence.topic: Peer self-roundtrip is not independent geometry evidence
evidence.observed: The cited tests include a fabricated SAB framing payload and a locally constructed planar body passed through the same writer and reader. These are useful generated-codec consistency controls but do not constitute an independent producer or imported-shape metric witness.
doesNotEstablish: source-native dimensions for external drawings
AutoCAD/ODA/third-party reader acceptance
independent B-rep validity from payload presence alone
evidence.planUse: Keep generated/self-roundtrip evidence separate from external semantic evidence; require source-authored expectations or a different producer plus a separate reader/kernel for semantic claims.

refinesExistingOwners: S2.3.9.4.29 ACIS writer completeness and owner/block census
nextActions: Continue local fast tests and implementation slices; do not add external peers to per-slice validation.
At one optional composed checkpoint, pin the OpenCADStudio app and locked codec/kernel sources and use a locally generated asymmetric vector.
Separate exact carrier, typed entity, owner/block closure, renderer fallback, B-rep metrics, and native-target acceptance.
Do not treat the open BRL-CAD patch as a complete POLYFACE semantic rule; preserve negative visibility markers and the zero terminator.
Keep J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 explicitly DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
